Translation of letter to Secretary
from the Bureau of Education.
Dated 7th June, 1934.

Lectures for Primary School.

For the benefit of graduates of Primary and
Middle Schools in the Special District, we propose to
give lectures on "The Pursuit of Higher Studies and
Selection of Occupation" in the Assembly Halls of the
Western, Northern and Kinchow Road Primary Schools on
the 10th and 17th June, both in the forenoon and in the
afternoon. The Council is asked to oblige us by instruct-
ing the Education Department to notify the Schools con-
cerned so that we may be allowed to use their Assembly
Halls at the appointed time. Reply solicited.

(Chopped) Bureau of Education.

教育局致秘书函件的译文。
日期：1934年6月7日。

小学讲座。

为惠及特别区内小学及中学的毕业生，我们拟于6月10日及17日，在西区、北区及锦州路小学的礼堂举行关于“升学与择业”的讲座，每日分上午和下午进行。请理事会惠予协助，指令教育科通知有关学校，以便我们获准在指定时间使用其礼堂。盼复。

（盖章）教育局。
